acceptance: Slot limits, waiting ranks, duplicate peer handling, and queue ordering are deterministic.
evidence: UploadQueue enforces active slot and waiting caps, rejects duplicate user hashes on different endpoints, keeps duplicate endpoint ranks stable, and promotes the next waiting peer when an active slot is removed.

acceptance: Start-upload, accept-upload, queue rank, no-file, and range serving use shared-store truth.
evidence: Upload decisions build truthful AcceptUploadRequest, QueueRank, FileRequestNoFile, or QueueFull frames. build_shared_part_frame reads only verified shared ranges and emits normal or I64 part payloads from shared-store truth.

acceptance: Waiting, uploading, unknown, and file-not-found send truthful UDP responses.
evidence: handle_udp_reask returns rank-zero ACKs only for active upload peers, ranked ACKs for waiting peers, QueueFull for unknown peers, and FileNotFound for missing or mismatched shared files.
